title: Cisco Certified Networking Professional | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Cisco Certified Networking Professional. Category: Networking. Duration: 5 months. Description: Determine network resources needed for implementing EIGRP on a network. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
